Resolves #22058

Related: #21942, #21835, #21975

Five examples that configure both Neo themes, with Neo Dark listed first, now start in the theme their catalog link names. They are Breadcrumb Toolbar, the file Context Menu, the form app (Multi-Step Account Form), Dock Perspectives and Pop-outs, and Dock Pane Pop-out. Each passed a bare main view, so `?theme=neo-theme-neo-light` never reached it and a visitor from the light Portal landed on a dark page. Each now starts through `resolveStartTheme`, the per-example line about sixty examples already carry. The two dock examples run on a SharedWorker, so they read the booting window's config, as Dock Choreography does. Emmy found the five in her #21942 census and confirmed the resolver in scratch.

Evidence: L3 (the catalog theme spec in Chromium on a dev server, red on `dev`'s five `app.mjs` files) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-3).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs` › "Dual-theme examples that list Neo Dark first" opens each of the five from a light link, then a dark one. Red on `dev`: with the five `app.mjs` files swapped back, all five fail the light check. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the same test's second load reuses the browser context, so the two SharedWorker docks must follow the second link's `?theme=`; both pass. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `StandaloneExamplesThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs` (toggles, and propagation to the dock examples' child windows) and `ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs` run 38/38 at this head. |

Frame critique: in Neo Light the step list sits on white while the page around the form card is light grey. That is the form app's own light palette, which this change does not touch. On `dev`, the root viewport from a light link carries no theme class at all; the body falls back to the first configured theme.
